title: On Marking the spot with a small cross
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：mark　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mark 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the athlete ① marked the spot with a small cross in public, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② marks the spot with a small cross in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ mark the spot with a small cross at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ marked the spot with a small cross before — a line in the programme for September 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Marking the spot with a small cross in public, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ mark the end of the harvest in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Mark the end of the harvest at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ marks the end of the harvest in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ marked the spot with a small cross again when nobody else would.

⑩ To mark the spot with a small cross, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody marks the spot with a small cross in silence again and somebody must mark the spot with a small cross in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 标注（一般过去式 marked the spot with a small cross：1963 年运动员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 标注（一般现在 marks the spot with a small cross：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 标注（不定式 to mark the spot with a small cross：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 标注（过去完成时 had marked the spot with a small cross：1957 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 标注（动名词 marking the spot with a small cross 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 纪念（mark the end of the harvest：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去纪念为收冬办个纪念）
G. v. 纪念（mark the end of the harvest：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 标注（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 marks the end of the harvest，而母亲又一次 marked the spot with a small cross）

mark 意为“标注”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要标注用一个小十字标出那个位置，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 mark 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the athlete marked the spot with a small cross in public, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete marks the spot with a small cross in silence whenever the stadium asks.
Marking the spot with a small cross in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever mark the end of the harvest in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium marks the end of the harvest in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother marked the spot with a small cross again, and the stadium remembered that half.
